title: API Acceleration
description: Akamai's API Acceleration improves the performance, security, and scalability of your APIs.  API Acceleration has a specialized network of servers, metadata optimization, and mapping strategies designed to meet the unique requirements and challenges of delivering performant API and beacon traffic.
